sections.shortTitle: Exclusive Fishery Zone Regulation of Fishing Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXIX OF 1983
ORDINANCE XXIX OF 1983
EXCLUSIVE FISHERY ZONE (REGULATION OF FISHING) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
1983
An Ordinance to amend the Exclusive Fishery Zone (Regulation of
Fishing) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th November, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance is made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may bb called
the Exclusive Fishery Zone (Regulation of Fishing) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

An Ordinance to amend the Exclusive Fishery Zone (Regulation of

[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th November, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance is made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 1, Act XXXII of 1975.-I-n the Exclusive
Fishery Zone (Regulation of Fishing) Act, 1975 (XXXII of 1975), hereinafter referred
to as the said Act, in section 1, for subsection (2) the following shall be
substituted, namely :--
"(2) It
extends to the whole of Pakistan and to waters within the Zone."

An Ordinance to amend the Exclusive Fishery Zone (Regulation of
Fishing) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th November, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance is made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
3. Amendment of section 2, Act XXXII of 1975.--In the said Act, in
section 2 .--
(a) in clause (g), the word
"and". at the end, shall be omitted ;
(b) in clause (h), for the
full-stop at the end the semi-colon and word " ; and" shall be
substituted ; and
(c) after clause (h), amended as
aforesaid, the following new clause shall be added, namely :-
"(i)
"Zone" means the Exclusive Economic Zone specified in section 6 of
the Territorial Waters and Maritime Zones Act, 1976 (LXXXII of 1976).".

4. Amendment of section 9, Act XXXIl of 1975.-- In the said Act, in
section 9.-
(a) in
subsection (1), for the words "fine which may extend to five thousand
rupees" the words and commas "rigorous imprisonment for a term which
